report.summary: Both failures come from one product defect: the app accepts a publication year one year in the future. The API returns 201 instead of 422, so the UI never shows the 'Year must be between' error. Fix the year check in app/main.py validate_book (line 94) first, and confirm whether the year_off_by_one seeded bug is switched on in the environment that produced this run, since the workflow file does not set BUGS.

causes.title: Server accepts a publication year of next year (year_off_by_one bug active)
causes.explanation: validate_book allows years up to this_year + 1 when the 'year_off_by_one' flag is in BUGS, so a book dated next year is stored with 201 instead of being rejected with 422. The tests expect rejection, and the app's own error message says the valid range ends at the current year, so the tests are right. The API test fails on the status code. The UI test then waits for the error element, which never appears because the book was saved and is listed with year 2027. The year-zero case passes because the bug only moves the upper bound. Nothing in the repo sets BUGS (the CI workflow does not), so the flag must be coming from the environment the run used. Even so, the behavior is wrong for the code as written and the failure would recur on every run that has the flag set.
evidence: app/main.py:94: max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year
app/main.py:95-96: if not 1 <= book.year <= max_year: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
app/main.py:9: docstring: year_off_by_one  accepts next year as a publication year
UI failure: Expect "to_contain_text" get_by_test_id("error") ... Actual value: None, Error: element(s) not found
UI aria snapshot shows the saved row: row "Future-75f0a181 Someone 2027 Delete", so the server accepted the book
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:42-44: books.add(title, "Someone", str(date.today().year + 1)); expect(books.error).to_contain_text("Year must be between")
tests/api/test_books_api.py:58 and 61: year_zero case is not in the failure list, consistent with the bug affecting only the upper bound
causes.suggested_fix: Make the seeded bug inactive for this environment: remove year_off_by_one from the BUGS variable in CI and in any deployed test app. If the flag is meant to stay on, the tests are right to fail, so mark them as expected failures (xfail with a reason) until the bug is fixed. For the real fix, drop the '+ 1' so max_year is always this_year, then rerun both tests.
